messages:
carl-support: Hey team, customer @ben reports 400 on /v1/rerank. They say it started after a client-side update. Payload attached.
ben-customer: we upgraded our mobile sdk and now rerank returns 400. here's sample request we send from device (copied from logs).
ben-customer: ```POST /v1/rerank HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded
Authorization: Bearer xxxxx

body=%7B%22items%22%3A%5B%7B%22id%22%3A%22123%22%2C%22candidates%22%3A%5B%5D%2C%22query%22%3A%22find+best%22%7D%5D%2C%22topk%22%3A%225%22%7D```
carl-support: notable: Content-Type is form-encoded and the JSON is URL-encoded into `body=`. also `topk` is a string. clients used to send raw JSON.
alex-engineer: yep that will break our parser. we expect application/json and `topk` numeric and `candidates` non-empty array. server returns 400 with error "invalid_request: items[0].candidates must be a non-empty array".
maria-support: customer says some requests are fine and only some fail (intermittent). could be proxy or a library change that switches to form-encoding on retries.
sophie-qa: repro steps from my laptop: i sent same body as raw JSON with Content-Type: application/json and got 200. then i sent `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` with body=urlencoded JSON -> got 400. logs show our validation layer decodes body as string and then JSON parse fails -> returns 400 early. snippet from our access logs: "POST /v1/rerank 400 14ms - invalid_request: failed to parse items array".
carl-support: customer also attached one failing payload where `candidates` exists but contains objects with `score` as string "N/A". we should flag that too.
ben-customer: example failing candidate entry: `{"id":"a1", "text":"opt", "score":"N/A"}`. our backend used to accept missing scores but now validation rejects non-numeric scores.
alex-engineer: validation tightened last week (PR #814). PR enforced `candidates[].score` to be numeric when present and `topk` must be integer. but we didn't add migration note. i can roll a fallback to coerce string numbers ("5") to int and ignore non-parsable scores with a warning header.
maria-support: customer impact: batch rerank jobs failing intermittently -> degraded ux. would like a quick patch and a mitigation we can tell them.
sophie-qa: mitigation: advise client to set Content-Type: application/json and to ensure `topk` is numeric and `candidates` is not empty. also suggest server-side: return more descriptive error pointing to the exact field.
alex-engineer: immediate plan: (1) return improved 400 message listing offending path (items[0].candidates empty / topk wrong type) in next deploy, (2) short-term runtime tolerance: if Content-Type is form-encoded and body contains `body=` that looks like JSON, attempt auto-decode and validate, (3) add docs note and support article.
carl-support: can you add a troubleshooting checklist I can send to Ben? include curl examples.
alex-engineer: checklist + curl examples: ```# good
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \n  -d '{"items":[{"id":"123","query":"find best","candidates":[{"id":"a","text":"opt1","score":0.8}] }],"topk":5}'
# bad (form-encoded) - will 400
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded' \n  -d "body=$(printf '%s' '{"items":[{"id":"123","query":"x","candidates":[]}]}' | jq -s -R -r @uri)"
```
maria-support: i'll send that to Ben now and include ETA for the fallback patch.
deploy-bot: Scheduled rolling deploy to staging for patch coerce-topk-and-form-decode at 2024-11-02T03:00:00Z :rocket:
carl-support: thanks. Ben, sending checklist. please try the curl good example and confirm. if you still see 400, paste the raw request headers and body.
ben-customer: sent good example from our CI, it worked. will audit mobile SDK for new encoder. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
